record.label: D4 official IPC rank-35 drift control
record.summary: The unchanged scored D4 bank also returns through the official client/server path with generic native/remote drift: RMS 2.67e-9 and maximum 1.1920928955078125e-7. Byte drift is thus not D5-specific and does not explain the board failures.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved as the negative control showing that tiny official native/remote byte drift is generic rather than a D5 exception.
